name: short_natural_question_survives
input: Which CRM is best?
expected: Keep unchanged: it is short, category-visible, and asks for a recommendation; there is no minimum word count.

name: first_person_request_survives
input: I'm looking for an AI search visibility tool for a small SEO agency.
expected: Accept as a natural conversational request even without a question mark.

name: keyword_phrase_repaired
input: AI search tracking tool demo request
expected: Rewrite as a standalone natural question and retain the phrase only as retrieval/evidence input.

name: category_ambiguity_repaired
input: Which brand tracking tools are best?
expected: Add an AI-search or AI-generated-answer qualifier before monitoring.

name: title_field_not_sampled
input: Best AI Search Visibility Tools for 2026
expected: Store as title_seed, generate a separate user_question, and never sample the title directly.

name: quota_failure_blocks_batch
input: A configured 50-question batch contains 49 rows.
expected: Fail the batch and fill the missing intent-matrix cell before collection.

name: explicit_professional_term_survives
input: The topic names answer engine optimization and the audience includes AEO leaders.
expected: Add AEO to required_term_coverage and preserve it in natural Generic and Branded questions instead of rewriting every occurrence as AI search visibility.

name: ambiguous_acronym_gets_context
input: Which GEO tools are best for agencies?
expected: Expand GEO at least once in the bank and add AI-search context to acronym-only standalone questions.

name: professional_term_not_stuffed
input: A bank already has three distinct GEO questions and the remaining questions use natural AI search visibility language.
expected: Keep the natural-language questions; do not replace synonyms or append GEO merely to increase keyword count.

name: translation_required
input: A monitoring row has a natural English user_question but an empty zh_translation.
expected: Fail the row until a non-empty Chinese translation accurately represents the English question.

name: generic_product_alias_boundary
input: A Generic question avoids brand_name but contains the configured product_name or alias.
expected: Fail the row because Generic brand boundaries include brand_name, product_name, aliases, and competitors.

name: promotional_driver_cap
input: A large share of the bank uses best, top, most, or review/reviews wording.
expected: Do not fail on wording alone; warn and review whether the questions represent distinct condition values and answer boundaries.

name: pseudo_diversity_warning
input: A 50-question bank has 49 one-off cluster values and 44 questions start with How, What, or Which.
expected: Keep deterministic hard gates separate, but warn for cluster pseudo-diversity and concentrated sentence openings so semantic review can inspect templates.

name: adjacent_competitor_dimension_boundary
input: A frozen adjacent competitor allows only AI answer monitoring as a shared comparison dimension.
expected: Generate a neutral AI-answer-monitoring comparison only; reject overall superiority, ranking, or full-substitution questions.

name: fallback_without_shared_dimensions
input: A frozen fallback competitor has an empty comparison_policy.allowed_dimensions array.
expected: Keep it in the formal three, but generate only category-relationship or use-scenario clarification questions and never ask which product is better.

name: term_assessment_cannot_be_omitted
input: A newly generated v2 bank omits both professional_term_assessment and required_term_coverage.
expected: Fail the bank; new output must record a completed assessment even when no professional term is required.

name: most_and_review_false_positives
input: The bank contains 'Which metrics matter most?' and 'Who should review AI-generated claims?'.
expected: Do not treat these as commercial-ranking signals; inspect context only if the batch appears repetitive.

name: metadata_pseudo_diversity_warning
input: More than 80% of scenario and constraint labels occur only once.
expected: Keep the bank structurally valid but warn that metadata granularity may be fabricating diversity.

name: six_cells_have_distinct_answer_endpoints
input: Recommendation, Comparison, and Decision questions reuse the same condition values and differ mainly by wording.
expected: Recommendation asks for candidates, Comparison asks for differences and a trade-off, and Decision asks for a final fit judgment; identical condition values cannot be reused as separate intents by changing wording.

name: branded_comparison_three_plus_two
input: Five Branded Comparison questions cover only two of the three frozen competitors or repeat five one-to-one templates.
expected: Require one solo question for each formal competitor plus two key-factor or multi-brand questions, while preserving each competitor's comparison policy.

name: target_audience_coverage
input: Some configured audiences appear less often than others in the Generic bank.
expected: Report the distribution for semantic review without enforcing per-audience minimums or a 40% cap; every retained question must still have commercial value.

name: pricing_is_dynamic_not_fixed
input: The topic has no useful public pricing or cost decision, but the generator adds two generic pricing questions to satisfy a fixed quota.
expected: Remove the fixed quota. Ask pricing, plan fit, quote drivers, or total cost only when it materially affects selection, and never invent an amount.

name: bpi_placeholder_hides_category
input: What certification coverage criteria should buyers evaluate when choosing specialized product suppliers?
expected: Fail category visibility and the placeholder blacklist because a standalone reader cannot identify rechargeable batteries.

name: category_visible_but_not_commercial
input: What certifications should OEM procurement managers evaluate when choosing a rechargeable battery manufacturer?
expected: Fail commercial_intent during second-pass review: the answer is a certification checklist rather than battery supplier candidates or a trade-off.

name: category_product_term_is_enough
input: Which battery suppliers offer low-MOQ custom LiPo cells for wearable startups?
expected: Pass category visibility without mechanically repeating the Topic phrase because battery suppliers and LiPo cells identify the category.

name: yes_no_decision_is_allowed
input: Is BPI the right rechargeable battery manufacturer for a medical device team needing custom pack validation?
expected: Allow the Yes/No form because a useful answer must explain fit, conditions, and risks; Branded questions are not natural-mention scoring prompts.

name: awareness_is_retired
input: A new v3 bank contains funnel_intent=awareness.
expected: Fail the bank. New commercial question banks only use recommendation, comparison, and decision.

name: intent_counts_are_not_fixed
input: A 50-question bank keeps Generic/Branded at 40/10, contains all three commercial intents, but does not use 12/25/13.
expected: Pass intent coverage. Do not enforce exact recommendation, comparison, decision, or six-cell counts.

name: commercial_condition_types_are_not_intent_types
input: Target audience, evaluation criterion, constraint, and comparison object conditions appear across different question forms.
expected: Assign recommendation when the answer should give candidates, comparison when it should give differences and a trade-off, and decision when it should give a final fit judgment; do not bind a condition type to one funnel intent.

name: one_brand_sentiment_prompt_per_topic
input: A company Topic has no fixed Evaluate prompt, has two of them, or labels one as recommendation.
expected: Fail the bank. Require exactly one Branded prompt per Topic using Evaluate the {category} company {brand} on {topic}, classified as decision without a separate sentiment-intent field.

name: bpi_task_89_4768_thermal_management_drift
input: Task 89 #4768 evaluates OEM/ODM rechargeable battery manufacturers, but the question asks the AI to select thermal management vendors.
expected: Fail topic_aligned and category_aligned. Thermal management vendors are a different purchasing set from rechargeable battery manufacturers.

name: bpi_task_89_4751_4753_4755_4757_4759_false_recommendation
input: Task 89 #4751/#4753–#4755/#4757–#4759 are labeled recommendation but ask only for procurement knowledge, certification criteria, or evaluation frameworks.
expected: Fail commercial_intent. A recommendation label is not enough; a reasonable answer must provide battery manufacturer candidates, a recommendation, or a clear trade-off.

name: bpi_task_89_4778_containerized_ess_drift
input: Task 89 #4778 evaluates OEM/ODM rechargeable battery manufacturers, but the question asks the AI to select containerized energy storage system providers.
expected: Fail topic_aligned and category_aligned. A containerized energy storage system provider is not the same purchasing object as a rechargeable battery manufacturer.

name: bpi_task_89_4789_project_partner_drift
input: Task 89 #4789 evaluates OEM/ODM rechargeable battery manufacturers, but the question asks for a long-term partner for a 500 MWh energy storage project.
expected: Fail topic_aligned and category_aligned. A project delivery partner is a broader commercial object with a different candidate set and evaluation criteria.
